Agent Name: Assistant
Step Number: 12
Reason for Mistake: The Assistant relied on an incomplete list of stations from the MBTA page and counted only six intermediate stops (Norwood Central, Norwood Depot, Islington, Dedham Corporate Center, Endicott, Readville), omitting additional stops between South Station and Windsor Gardens (e.g., Back Bay, Ruggles, Hyde Park and/or the Fairmount branch stops used by Franklin trains as of May 2023). The Assistant failed to verify the completeness of the station list before counting, leading to an undercount (6 instead of the correct 10).
